prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency for everyone — the right agency depends on your goals (brand vs. performance), channel focus (SEO, paid search, social, content, email), industry, budget and whether you want a local partner or are fine with a remote/remote-first team.

If you tell me your primary goals, budget and industry I’ll give a tailored shortlist. Meanwhile, here’s a quick starting framework and a few reputable agencies with strong San Francisco presence or roots:

How to pick the “best” for you
- Define primary objective: revenue, leads, brand awareness, app installs, etc.
- Channels and services needed: SEO/PPC, social ads, content, CRO, analytics/data engineering.
- Budget and contract length: retainer vs. project vs. performance.
- Look for relevant case studies, client references, measurable KPIs, and transparent reporting.
- Check reviews on Clutch, G2, Google/LinkedIn and ask for team bios and past results.

San Francisco agencies to consider (by specialty)
- Growth/performance marketing: Ladder — growth-driven strategies and paid acquisition.
- Performance/paid search & analytics: 3Q Digital — paid search, programmatic and analytics.
- Data-driven CRM and personalization: Merkle — enterprise-level CRM, analytics and media.
- Experience design & digital transformation: AKQA — product/experience design, creative tech.
- Creative & branding: Goodby Silverstein & Partners — creative campaigns and brand strategy.

If you want, tell me:
- Your business type/industry
- Main goal (leads, sales, brand, installs)
- Monthly budget range
- Preference for boutique vs. large/global agency

I’ll produce a short, prioritized list of 4–6 agencies in SF (or remote options) with why each fits and suggested questions to ask them.
